department: Department of Physics (Graduate School of Arts and Sciences)

deadline.value: PhD Physics: December 15 (year inferred; portal opens October 1). Physics MS has a separate Jan 15 / rolling-to-May 1 schedule.
deadline.quote: PhD | December 1 | Biology, Psychology, Chemistry | December 15 | Anthropology (not accepting applications this cycle), Art & Architectural History, Economics, English, History, Media Studies, Nursing, Physics, Politics, Religious Studies, French

app_fee.value: USD 85, non-refundable; one GSAS program per season
app_fee.quote: A non-refundable fee of $85 is due at the time the application is submitted.

fee_waiver.value: Waivers for US citizens/PRs with hardship; internationals only if citizens of UN least developed countries (India is not on the list); GSAS gives no waiver codes
fee_waiver.quote: International Applicants: Citizens of the countries listed below, which are recognized by the United Nations as least developed countries (LDCs), are eligible to receive a need-based application fee waiver. | Please note that international applicants from countries not included in the United Nations' list of LDCs will not qualify for this fee waiver.

gre_general.value: General GRE not required for Physics
gre_general.quote: Applicants to degree programs in Physics require a valid Physics GRE score; general GRE scores are not required.

gre_physics.value: Valid Physics GRE score required (self-reported at application; official scores needed on matriculation)
gre_physics.quote: Applicants to degree programs in Physics require a valid Physics GRE score; general GRE scores are not required.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 90 with sections S22/W22/R23/L23 (before 1/21/26) or 4.5 overall (new scale); IELTS 7.0 each section; DET 130; committees may consider lower scores
toefl_min.quote: Taken before 1/21/26: 90 overall, with sectional minimums of 22 in speaking, 22 in writing, 23 in reading, and 23 in listening

english_waiver.value: Automatic waiver if the whole undergraduate degree is from an institution where English is the primary language of instruction, with evidence (transcript or primary-language certificate); other proof considered case by case
english_waiver.quote: Automatic waiver. The TOEFL requirement is waived for applicants who have earned or will earn an undergraduate degree entirely at an institution where English is the primary language of instruction. To receive this waiver, submit supporting evidence, such as a transcript or a primary language certificate, as part of the electronic application.

supervisor.value: Not stated on the page checked

funding.value: Doctoral admits get at least five years of support: 12-month stipend $37,260, full tuition/fees remission, single health insurance
funding.quote: The Graduate School offers doctoral students a minimum of five years of financial support upon admission, including twelve-month living support of $37,260 and full remission of tuition, fees and the premium for single-person coverage
